What it does: 250 mm wheel instead of 225 mm turns 27 % slower for the same air (1,200 vs 1,650 rpm at Turbo)
Small saw-tooth edges on each blade break up the swirl that makes the 'whoosh'
9 blades at slightly different angles spread the humming tone over many frequencies, so there is no single whine
Smooth current to the motor: no electrical buzz, PWM at 25 kHz is above human hearing
23 m2 LifeHEPA: air passes at 0.85 cm/s, only 130 Pa total, so the fan works gently
Rounded 180 mm inlet ring, no sharp edge for air to tear on
10 mm melamine foam (V-0) in the fan scroll and outlet absorbs fan noise before it leaves
Pop-up gap all round: air leaves at about 1.4 m/s, so no rushing sound
Fan vibration does not reach the shell, so the body does not hum
Stiff ribs stop the panels drumming
Fan speed changes slowly (no sudden roar), skips any speed where the unit resonates, Auto is capped at night, beeps off at night
Pop-up uses StealthChop silent stepper drive; Home model has no relays
